reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a video camera enclosing a microphone, crossed out by a diagonal slash to mean disabled AV (both camera and mic off/blocked). While originated as a UI toggle state in calling apps, it fits specific tasks around revoking camera/mic privacy permissions, troubleshooting dead AV input, disabling recording, or cancelling video calls. At tiny list sizes the nested microphone can blur into the slash, making it look like a standard 'camera off' icon.
